|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">典型的な多目的ドロイド。ビークルやコンピュータを操作／修理する。帝国軍がタンティヴィIVのコンピュータ・バンクから情報を引き出すのに使用したのが、R4-M9である。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine).

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any vehicle (except a creature vehicle). Add 1 to that vehicle's power, maneuver and landspeed. Even without personnel, this droid can remain aboard alone and drive the vehicle. It has no capability as an astromech droid.

'''Lore:''' A typical multipurpose droid. Operates/repairs vehicles and computers. R4-M9 is the droid the Empire used to extract information from Tantive IV's computer banks.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says there need not be personnel aboard; the English says the droid may drive by itself without presence. Both give +1 power, maneuver and landspeed to a non-creature vehicle and deny astromech capability. The Japanese lore omits the English word once.<ref name="comparison">[ Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:46.</ref>
|notes=Droids have no ability.<ref name="droid-ability" /> The 2023 Advanced Rulebook treats a droid's ability as an unmodifiable zero when a card compares. 77, Characters - Droid. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
